subject: Request: Riverton thesis annotation pilot - credit top-up & short extension
messages:
From: Dr. Emily Chan <emily.chan@riverton.edu>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-28T14:12:00-04:00
Subject: Request: short trial top-up & credits for thesis annotation pilot

Hi Lauren,

Hope you’re well — we met briefly at the Community Colleges AI summit last month. I’m leading a small thesis-driven annotation pilot at Riverton Community College (RCC) and we’re running into token limits on our trial account. The team includes four undergrads and two grad supervisors working on speech-to-text annotation and privacy-preserving redaction.

We’d greatly appreciate a small one-time top-up of trial credits (approx. 50k tokens) and a 30-day extension so the students can finish the annotation pass and complete the evaluation for a capstone thesis. This is a public-interest educational project — we have IRB paperwork and a short scope doc attached.

Quick context:
- Project: Thesis annotation and evaluation for low-resource ASR (RCC Speech Lab)
- Timeline: needs 3 more weeks of active usage
- Outcome: reproducible dataset + short technical report; we’ll credit Redwood Inference in acknowledgements

Attachments: RCC_Student_List.csv, IRB_waiver.pdf, pilot_scope.docx

Could you let me know if RCC is eligible and who on your side can authorize a small extension/top-up? Happy to provide any additional details.

Thanks,
Emily
Dr. Emily Chan
Assistant Professor, Computer Science
Riverton Community College
emily.chan@riverton.edu
(555) 321-4470
From: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>

Cc: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-28T16:05:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Request: short trial top-up & credits for thesis annotation pilot

Hi Emily — great to hear from you and thanks for the clear summary + attachments. This is exactly the sort of academic pilot we try to support.

Next steps on our side: I’ll route the request to our pilot credits team for approval. Can you confirm the following so I can expedite:
1) A short estimate of token usage per student (or total approximate tokens needed)
2) Whether any of the student data contains PII that requires stricter handling beyond our standard edu policy
3) Any procurement/PO constraints (are you able to accept a credit allocation via our portal or do you need a formal PO)?

If you’re okay I’ll loop in Aditya (pilot credits approvals) and Monica (education partnerships) to approve the one-time 50k top-up + 30-day extension.

Appreciate the offer to credit Redwood in the report — that helps. I’ll be back within 24 hours with an internal note.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
From: Dr. Emily Chan <emily.chan@riverton.edu>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lowe <marcus.lowe@riverton.edu>, rcc-research-admin@riverton.edu
Date: 2026-10-28T18:22:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Request: short trial top-up & credits for thesis annotation pilot

Hi Lauren — thanks for the quick reply. Answers below:

1) Token estimate: we tracked a sample run — ~10k tokens per student for the annotation pass (including prompts and model outputs). For four students + margin we estimated ~50k total.
2) Data: audio is student-submitted recordings of short oral presentations; transcripts will be de-identified. We have the IRB waiver attached; no special PII beyond names which will be removed before any shared dataset.
3) Procurement: RCC does not have a PO for this pilot; we need the credit allocation as a one-off grant via your portal. If there’s a form we can sign, we’ll do it.

If Aditya / Monica need more detail I can share the student roster and a short sample transcript.

Best,
Emily
